scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @setlist/server" "npm run dev -w @setlist/web"
scripts.dev:sim: concurrently -n sim,server,web -c magenta,blue,green "python remote-script/simulator/sim.py" "npm run dev -w @setlist/server" "npm run dev -w @setlist/web"
